install:
set -eo pipefail

# OS build dependencies (no NodeSource)
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev curl git ca-certificates

# nvm — download script first, then execute (never pipe curl directly to bash)
NVM_INSTALL="/tmp/nvm-install-$$.sh"
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.2/install.sh -o "$NVM_INSTALL"
bash "$NVM_INSTALL"
rm -f "$NVM_INSTALL"

export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"

# exec-daemon bundles Node v22; strip from PATH so nvm does not alias to "system"
export PATH="$(echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^/exec-daemon$' | paste -sd: -)"

nvm install
nvm alias default "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)"
nvm use --silent

NVM_VER="$(nvm_version "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)")"
export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin:$PATH:/exec-daemon"

# Agent Shell uses non-interactive bash -c without .bashrc; shim node before exec-daemon in PATH
NVM_BIN_DIR="${NVM_DIR}/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin"
for _tool in node npm npx; do
  if [ -x "${NVM_BIN_DIR}/${_tool}" ]; then
    sudo tee "/usr/local/cargo/bin/${_tool}" > /dev/null <<SHIM_EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec "${NVM_BIN_DIR}/${_tool}" "\$@"
SHIM_EOF
    sudo chmod +x "/usr/local/cargo/bin/${_tool}"
  fi
done

# Persist Node 24 PATH for login/interactive shells
SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV="${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"
cat > "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV}" << 'SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV_EOF'
# Spirit Agent Cloud: nvm Node from nodejs.org, not exec-daemon bundled node
export BASH_ENV="${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"
export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
if [ -s "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh"
  export PATH="$(echo "${PATH}" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^/exec-daemon$' | paste -sd: -)"
  if [ -f /workspace/.nvmrc ]; then
    nvm use --silent 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    nvm use default --silent 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  NVM_VER="$(nvm current 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  if [ -n "${NVM_VER}" ] && [ "${NVM_VER}" != "system" ] && [ "${NVM_VER}" != "none" ]; then
    export PATH="${NVM_DIR}/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin:${PATH}"
  fi
  export PATH="${PATH}:/exec-daemon"
fi
if [ -s "${HOME}/.cargo/env" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "${HOME}/.cargo/env"
fi
export PATH="${HOME}/.cargo/bin:${PATH}"
SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV_EOF

SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER='# spirit-agent-cloud-env'
if [ -f "${HOME}/.bashrc" ] && ! grep -qF "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER}" "${HOME}/.bashrc"; then
  {
    echo ""
    echo "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER}"
    echo '[ -f "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh" ] && . "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"'
  } >> "${HOME}/.bashrc"
fi
if [ -f "${HOME}/.profile" ] && ! grep -qF "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER}" "${HOME}/.profile"; then
  {
    echo ""
    echo "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER}"
    echo '[ -f "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh" ] && . "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"'
  } >> "${HOME}/.profile"
fi

sudo tee /etc/profile.d/spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh > /dev/null << 'PROFILED_EOF'
# Spirit Agent Cloud: source user env for login shells
if [ -f "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"
fi
PROFILED_EOF

# Non-interactive bash -c (Agent Shell tool) reads BASH_ENV when exported in parent env
if ! sudo grep -qF 'BASH_ENV=' /etc/environment 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "BASH_ENV=${SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV}" | sudo tee -a /etc/environment > /dev/null
fi

# pnpm via corepack (matches package.json packageManager)
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.24.0 --activate

# Refresh shims if corepack added npm/npx paths under nvm bin
NVM_BIN_DIR="${NVM_DIR}/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin"
for _tool in node npm npx; do
  if [ -x "${NVM_BIN_DIR}/${_tool}" ]; then
    sudo tee "/usr/local/cargo/bin/${_tool}" > /dev/null <<SHIM_EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec "${NVM_BIN_DIR}/${_tool}" "\$@"
SHIM_EOF
    sudo chmod +x "/usr/local/cargo/bin/${_tool}"
  fi
done

# Rust stable >= 1.85 (apps/cli/Cargo.toml rust-version, edition 2024)
_need_rustup=0
if ! command -v rustc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  _need_rustup=1
else
  _rustc_ver="$(rustc --version | sed -n 's/rustc \([0-9]*\.[0-9]*\).*/\1/p')"
  if ! printf '%s\n%s\n' "1.85" "${_rustc_ver}" | sort -C -V >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    _need_rustup=1
  fi
fi
if [ "${_need_rustup}" -eq 1 ]; then
  RUSTUP_INIT="/tmp/rustup-init-$$.sh"
  curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs -o "$RUSTUP_INIT"
  bash "$RUSTUP_INIT" -y --default-toolchain stable --component clippy
  rm -f "$RUSTUP_INIT"
fi
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
[ -s "${HOME}/.cargo/env" ] && . "${HOME}/.cargo/env"
rustup default stable 2>/dev/null || true
rustup component add clippy 2>/dev/null || true
# Base image may ship rustc 1.83 in /usr/local/cargo/bin; prefer rustup toolchain
export PATH="${HOME}/.cargo/bin:${PATH}"

pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

# Build verification (aligned with .github/workflows/verify.yml)
pnpm turbo run build
pnpm exec oxlint --deny-warnings packages apps/desktop
pnpm exec oxfmt --check packages apps/desktop
cargo build -p spirit
cargo test -p spirit
cargo clippy --all-targets -p spirit -- -D warnings
start:
set -eo pipefail

if [ -f "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"
else
  export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
  export PATH="$(echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^/exec-daemon$' | paste -sd: -)"
  if [ -f /workspace/.nvmrc ]; then
    nvm use --silent 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  NVM_VER="$(nvm current 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  if [ "$NVM_VER" != "system" ] && [ "$NVM_VER" != "none" ]; then
    export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin:$PATH"
  fi
  export PATH="$PATH:/exec-daemon"
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  [ -s "${HOME}/.cargo/env" ] && . "${HOME}/.cargo/env"
fi
